sections.content: Spanish uses reflexive and reciprocal pronouns when people act on themselves or on one another. With reciprocal actions, expressions such as nos, se and el uno al otro make the relationship between the participants clear.

items.spanish: Nos apoyamos cuando tenemos problemas, porque confiamos unos en otros.
items.english: We support each other when we have problems because we trust one another.

items.spanish: Mis hermanas se ayudan cuando una de ellas necesita consejo.
items.english: My sisters help each other when one of them needs advice.

items.spanish: Después de discutir, se hablaron y se entendieron mejor.
items.english: After arguing, they spoke to each other and understood each other better.

items.spanish: Nos llevamos bien aunque a veces pensamos de manera diferente.
items.english: We get along well although sometimes we think differently.

sections.content: A reciprocal reading is especially clear when the subject is plural and the action logically goes both ways. Context often tells you whether nos/se is reflexive or reciprocal.
